map.直接成本 = 鱼苗 + 饲料 + 电费 + 药品: Direct cost = fry + feed + electricity + medicine
map.间接成本 = 人工 + 塘租 + 其他: Indirect cost = labour + pond rent + other
map.总成本 = 直接成本 + 间接成本: Total cost = direct cost + indirect cost
map.总收入 = 产量 × 单价 + 副产品收入: Total revenue = output × unit price + by-product revenue
map.毛利润 = 总收入 - 直接成本: Gross profit = total revenue - direct cost
map.净利润 = 总收入 - 总成本: Net profit = total revenue - total cost
map.利润率 = 净利润 / 总收入 × 100%: Profit margin = net profit / total revenue × 100%
map.投资回报率 ROI = 净利润 / 总成本 × 100%: Return on investment ROI = net profit / total cost × 100%
